about_the_game:
🐉 Dragon Fall

Genres: Action RPG | Adventure | Fantasy
Style: 2D Pixel Art with charming visuals and epic animations
Languages: Portuguese (Brazil), English
Game Mode: Single Player

Summary:
For millennia, dragons coexisted with humans, spreading fear and destruction wherever they went. They were, for the most part, hostile and ruthless creatures. But over time, they vanished... until now.

After a devastating attack on the continent of Seles, the young Cicipho finds his life turned upside down when his mother is kidnapped by a mysterious entity. Armed only with his courage, he embarks on a desperate journey to face ancient beasts, dark forces, and secrets buried in the past.

⚔️ Key Features:

Real-time combat: Dodge, run, and attack with swords, bows, or magic in intense and fluid battles.

Classic mechanics with a modern touch: Use consumable items, explore the world freely, and uncover hidden paths.

Immersive exploration: Travel through diverse environments in a richly crafted fantasy world in pixel art.

Captivating story: An emotional narrative about courage, sacrifice, and the bond between mother and son.

Charming visuals: 2D pixel art graphics with stunning animations that bring characters and monsters to life.

Get ready to face the rebirth of chaos... the fate of the world rests upon your blade.

Welcome to the world of Dragon Fall.
